posts.title: Building Effective Agents on z3cz.com
posts.description: How Anthropic's agent patterns map onto the z3cz.com runtime. The augmented LLM, prompt chaining, routing, parallelization, and autonomous agents, each shown as a shape on the canvas, with one catalog feeding both the node and tool registries.
